profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Intel Corporation
profile.summary:
An innovative, hands-on, self-starter, self-driving, and disciplined senior hw/sw validation engineer with over 23 years of management, leadership, and engineer experience.  Board expertise in development and use of test automation frameworks; Broad knowledge of logic design, physical design flows, verification flows, verification methodologies, infrastructures, automation, detail testplans, and software testing/Quality Assurance. Expert in the field of unit, integration, system testing, and GUI/UI base testing
•	Thirteen years of pre-silicon verification technical lead and team management of extremely complex logic blocks, for numerous highly successful Intel microprocessors, server and mobile chipsets
•	Six years of software verification/Quality Assurance technical lead of post-si debug tools 
•	Two years of post-silicon debug tool development
•	Two years of HW (Soc)/SW(OS, Drivers)/FW(BIOS) System enabling, integration, and testing

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Part of Intel/Microsoft features co-engineering team responsible for planning, enabling, integrating, and testing/execution to ensure new Windows OS features work best on Intel SoCs, and new Intel SoC features are fully supported by upcoming Windows OS releases. Scope of engineering included new feature dependency analysis, integration planning and execution, advanced OS/FW/driver/SW debug

positions.title: Senior Post-Silicon System Validation Engineer
positions.description:
•	Developed debug tools in python to support Power ON (PO) debug activities for Intel® Omni-Path Architecture (Intel® OPA) , through JTAG interface
•	Developed tests in C++ and use FPGA, Simics, and Emulation platforms as testing vehicles to validate Intel® Omni-Path Architecture (Intel® OPA) network switch

positions.title: Sr. Software Quality Assurance/Validation
positions.description: •	Architected and developed new test methodologies (unit, integration, system, code coverage) infrastructure, test frameworks to validate the hardware and software debug tools

positions.title: Logic Design Validation Manager/Technical Lead
positions.description:
•	Managed group of 9-10 senior and junior logic validation/verification/test engineers
•	Managed complex technology projects with aggressive schedules and scarce resources
•	Developed/reviewed Full Chip testplans focusing on the interfaces 
•	 Developed focused/random tests, executed and debugged tests 
•	Developed coverage points using Specman/SystemVerilog to use measure the coverage
•	Searched/developed/enhanced new/existed validation/test methodologies, tools, and environments in order to improve the quality of the designs

positions.title: Logic Design and Validation Engineer
positions.description:
•	Developed RTL/ASIC VHDL code via Mentor entry design tool (Renoir, HDS)
•	Developed testbench in C++ with C++ BFMs (Bus Functional Model). 
•       Synthesized the design and performed timing fixes and ran formal verification tools
•	Developed/reviewed testplan and developed focused/random tests using C++ to validate the design unit and ran regressions 
•	Developed coverage code using internal tools (PROTO, FSMCov) to monitor the basic and complex functional features of the designs and used this as indicators for the health of the designs.  Developed automation scripts (PERL) to automate the process of running and reporting regression runs.  
•	Developed GLS ((Gate Level Simulation) tests, ran and debugs the tests against GLS models to verify the timing correctness in the designs

honors.title: Division Team Award
honors.description: For the adoption, configuration, deployment and training of the TeamCity Build Management and Continuous Integration

honors.title: Intel Quality Award
honors.description: Excellence in Performance to Our Values.  Advanced Component Division
